title: Woodland Slide
description:
Embark on a relaxing journey in Woodland Slide! Slide the colorful jewels across wooden planks to create perfect matches and clear the board.

With every move, a new row of gems disappears, adding to the challenge. Use your strategy and unlock powerful abilities to remove gems, split them into smaller pieces, or clear entire rows.

Explore a serene, nature-inspired setting while testing your puzzle-solving skills. How far can you go in this addictive quest for the perfect match?

title: Bear vs Humans
description: Play as a crazy bear in this exciting 3D game! Ride a log with squirrels, destroy campsites, destroy objects and trees, and scare people with a loud roar. Use squirrels as throwing weapons and create chaos in the forest! Dive into a fun and wild world full of destruction and adventure!

title: Solitaire Klondike - Treasure Island
description:
Set sail on a thrilling pirate adventure! Explore mysterious islands, uncover hidden treasures, and help a fearless heroine escape ruthless villains.
Customize your experience with beautifully illustrated card decks, stunning animations, and magical boosters to tackle challenges.
Relax between games with mesmerizing music and lively animated characters. Dive into a world of adventure, mystery, and enchantment!

title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
description:
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem is an exciting motorcycle racing game. 
In this game you will become a motorcycle racer who travels through city streets and highways, avoiding collisions with other vehicles. You will be able to unlock faster and more powerful motorcycles, each with its own unique handling characteristics, as well as improve the characteristics of your motorcycle. One of the key features of the game is a realistic physics engine that makes the gameplay challenging and exciting.

title: Rift of Hell-Demons War
description:
Hordes of insidious demons are lurking in the hellish catacombs! Can you challenge hundreds of hellish creatures and destroy them all as you descend closer to the citadel?
You have several types of weapons at your disposal and an almost endless supply of ammo along the way!
With each step, collecting gold that falls from enemies, you will become stronger and stronger, strength, speed of movement, arsenal of deadly weapons, armor - all this will depend on your actions.

title: Geometry Open World
description: Geometry Open World is a fast-paced 2D action game where players pilot a ship through perilous obstacles, engage in thrilling battles against diverse enemies, and take on epic boss fights. With a vibrant and dynamic open world, strategic upgrades, and powerful abilities, you can chart your own path to triumph. Will you conquer the challenges, defeat the bosses, and rise to become the ultimate champion in this open-world geometric action adventure?

title: Monsterella Fantasy Makeup
description: Step into the monstrous world of beauty with "Monsterella Fantasy Makeup". This spookily engaging game lets you work your makeover magic on three iconic cartoon characters. In Frankie's unit, electrify her look with eerie eyeshadows, neon lipstick, shockingly cool hairstyles, and otherworldly outfits. Next, embrace Clawdeen's earthy mystique with jewel-toned makeup and howl-inducing wardrobe choices. Finally, express Draculaura's vamp chic vibe with dramatic makeup and goth-glam ensembles.

title: Jigsort Puzzles
description: Jigsort Puzzle is an app that is art puzzle and lets you complete jigsaw puzzle game for free! Various difficulty levels for casual and experiences puzzlers!

title: Spin Spin
description: Dive into Spin & Win Arcade, the ultimate spinning challenge! Test your reflexes as you spin the wheel, dodge traps, and chase rewards. Packed with arcade action, lucky spins, and endless fun, this game keeps players hooked. Perfect for US students searching for “spin wheel game,” “lucky spin,” or “spin the wheel challenge.” Get ready to spin fast, win big, and prove you’re the ultimate spinner champion!

title: Monster Slayer Merge & Survive
description: Welcome to our thrilling adventure game! Your journey consists of two main parts: merging items and exploring dungeons. Embark on this epic journey, combine powerful items, and conquer the depths of the dungeon!

title: Warfare 1942 - online shooter
description:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of World War II, where every battle is a unique fight for survival!
The game is designed for military enthusiasts and those who love intense online battles. It’s the perfect choice for players who prefer shooters with detailed gameplay, a variety of characters, and customization. Suitable for both seasoned fighters and newcomers.

title: Moto Attack Bike Racing
description: Moto Attack - Bike Racing is a fun bike racing simulator that takes speed and action to the next level. Drive your motorcycle and race against opponents. You can use weapons to attack them. Ride your bike through challenging tracks, and avoid obstacles like people crossing the street, cabs, boxes, etc.

title: 2048 Run Gorgeous Balls
description: 2048 Run: Gorgeous Balls is a fun arcade game that invites you to chase high scores in a delightful environment! In this creative 2048-style game, you’ll control a colorful array of balls as they race along a dynamic track.

title: Rush Car Driving - Race Master
description:
Rush Car Driving: Race Master is a driving game that delivers thrilling action as you navigate heavy traffic. 

Experience the adrenaline of high-speed racing in heavy traffic, where split-second decisions can be the difference between victory and defeat. Explore a variety of immersive environments, from busy urban highways to rural roads. 

Choose from a wide selection of cars, from sports cars to muscle machines. Buckle up and start the race!

title: Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator
description: Experience thrilling car crashes with realistic physics and intense destruction! Smash, wreck, and demolish vehicles in crash tests, demolition derbies, and sandbox modes. Dive into authentic impact mechanics and explore the ultimate crash simulator for car destruction fans!

title: Superhero Phone Simulator
description: Explore action-packed mini-games, customize your hero, and test your skills in fun challenges. Whether you enjoy racing, creativity, or exciting adventures, this app has everything you need for endless fun!

title: Turret Gunner
description:
You will find yourself in a thrilling air battle simulation, filled with exciting moments and countless enemy targets. You’ll be able to maneuver, shoot, and fight virtual opponents, experiencing the true adrenaline rush of an airstrike.

This captivating journey into the world of aviation will leave unforgettable impressions on fans of extreme action and flying. Feel like a real pilot and enjoy the excitement of aerial combat!

title: Brain Challenge
description:
This game will challenge your mind, think out of the box
Unexpected and mind-blowing answers will amaze you
250 Fun levels.

Features:
- Solve fun & mind-challenging puzzles
- Think out of the box
- Simple & addictive gameplay

title: Square World 3D
description: Square World 3D invites you into a completely open and huge craft world. In this world, you can use dozens of items / mines to design most of the things you can imagine and take actions in a world of your own. For example, first design, then fly over your unique design using the flying mode! This wonderful simulation game may become addictive for you. It is possible to design a completely different world in every game.

title: Spooky Halloween Hidden Pumpkin
description: In Spooky Halloween Hidden Pumpkin, you’ll explore haunted locations like creepy graveyards, abandoned houses, foggy forests, and more. Each level is uniquely designed with eerie Halloween-themed settings full of tricks and illusions. Your challenge is to locate 10 pumpkins hidden in plain sight within each scene. The faster you find them, the better your score!

title: Happy Fluffy Cubes
description: Happy Fluffy Cubes is a bright and fun 3D runner with adorable cube heroes, tricky traps, and a collection system! Choose your Fluffy and fly through levels full of danger: fire, ice, lasers, and spinning saws! Simple one-touch control, but surviving takes focus and reflexes.

title: Noob Ragdoll: Crazy Punch
description:
In "Noob Ragdoll: Crazy Punch", you'll see the world from a unique perspective - through the eyes of the glove itself! 

What Awaits You:
-First-person camera - Feel like you're delivering the punch yourself!
-Minecraft-style characters and vibrant action-packed scenes
-Epic punches and spectacular body launches on every level
-Multiple glove skins - choose yours and strike with style!

Test your accuracy and style in "Noob Ragdoll: Crazy Punch" - ragdoll physics has never been this dynamic!

title: Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles
description:
Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles is a relaxing jigsaw-style puzzle game where you assemble beautiful images piece by piece. Enjoy a calming experience as each picture comes to life under your fingertips!
Who It's For
Ideal for puzzle lovers, casual players, and anyone who enjoys peaceful, visually pleasing gameplay.
Start assembling now with Jigsaw Cards: Daily Puzzles — discover a cozy world of delightful puzzles!

title: Find The Missing Part
description: With 100 levels of increasingly challenging puzzles, this game will put your observation skills to the test like never before. Your task is to carefully examine the image and identify the missing sections from a set of 15 options provided. With only seconds to spare, you must make swift and accurate selections to complete the puzzle.

title: The Office Escape
description: The Office Escape is an exciting adventure where every step towards freedom becomes a test for the Regime and the thinking factor!

title: GT Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills?

title: Merry Christmas Connect
description: 《Cute Animal Connect》is a classic puzzle game where you connect identical patterns to eliminate them and score points. It tests your observation skills and reaction speed, with simple yet addictive gameplay that appeals to players of all ages.

title: Bus Jam
description: Welcome to the thrilling world of "Bus Jam: Clear the Bus Stop," presented by Golden Guns Studio, a color sort puzzle, fun-packed game where your task is to skillfully bus match 3d passengers onboard onto buses of the same color. Imagine a busy Bus Jam stop with vibrant buses and puzzled passengers eager to board. Your mission? Ensure each person finds their way to the right bus, and brace yourself as the color puzzle master.

title: Jelly Block Puzzle
description: Dive into the fun with our vibrant jelly merging game! Explore a world filled with countless levels, merge jellies, use power-ups, and stay entertained. Challenge your brain and see how far you can go in this delightful, jelly-colored adventure!

title: Metal Bay Top Blade Power
description:
Metal Bay Top Blade Power is a top-down action game inspired by spinning blade battles.

Control a powerful metal top blade and fight against enemies in the Metal Bay arena, using real-time physics-based collisions and spin power mechanics.

Master speed, impact force, and rotation control to understand when to attack, collide, or evade.

title: Dog Merge Mania
description: Merge cute puppies! Unlock breeds & grow your own fluffy dog paradise! A Relaxing Escape: The perfect mix of chill gameplay and light strategy.

title: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt
description: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt is an exciting endless bubble-shooting puzzle game where players must collect specific target bubbles along with rare magical crystals that appear among the bubbles. Aim carefully and match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear space while the bubble wall slowly moves toward the border line, increasing tension with every shot. Crystals are hidden within bubble clusters and must also be collected to progress and boost scores.

title: Candy Crunch: Sugar Escape
description:
Candy Crunch is a puzzle game where players move colorful block shapes to matching exits.

Each level challenges you to slide and reposition tightly packed blocks with different shapes and colors.

New obstacles appear as you progress, keeping gameplay fresh yet easy to understand. Levels are short, intuitive, and designed for quick, casual sessions.

With smooth controls and relaxing puzzles, Candy Crunch is perfect for logic and problem-solving fans.

title: Memory Wars
description: Memory Wars takes the classic memory-matching game to a whole new level with exciting battles, unique enemies, and powerful card effects. Use your brainpower and tactics to overcome a variety of foes and emerge victorious in every stage!

title: Sprunki Coloring Book
description:
Dive into a colorful adventure with Sprunki Coloring Book, a delightful game designed for kids and adults alike. Choose from a wide variety of adorable Sprunki characters, captivating landscapes, and fun designs to color your way. Whether you're a budding artist or simply looking to relax, Sprunki Coloring Book offers endless possibilities for self-expression.
Start coloring today and discover the joy of creativity with Sprunki Coloring Book!

title: Mega Lamba Ramp
description: Crazy car stunts and stunt car racing games that will give you the most thrilling experience. Perform dangerous stunts on impossible tracks in our racing and stunt simulator. Perform stunts on all the cars for your favorite characters to move to the next level!

title: Falling Blocks - Halloween Challenge
description: Step into the Halloween fun with Falling Blocks - Halloween Challenge, a thrilling match-3 arcade game! Match 3 or more spooky blocks, including pumpkins, ghosts, and skulls, as they rapidly fall from above. Your reflexes and strategy will be put to the test to clear the board and prevent a pile-up. Featuring vibrant Halloween visuals and addictive gameplay, this game provides hours of entertainment for all ages. Face the challenge, set high scores, and embrace the Halloween spirit!

title: Car Dealer Idle
description: Ever dreamed of becoming a top Car Dealer? In Car Dealer Idle, you’ll manage your own vehicle business. Buy and sell cars, expand your showroom, and grow into a real tycoon. Make smart management decisions, upgrade your dealership, and watch your profits skyrocket. Unlock more booths to sell cooler vehicles. Unlock repair areas, test drive areas, etc.

title: Planet Merge
description:
Embark on an interstellar journey in the most thrilling puzzle game of 2025! Merge planets in a cosmic challenge and create a universe of fun.
imple Yet Addictive Gameplay: Just drag and release to align the planets. Watch as they combine into spectacular new celestial bodies.

title: Squid Escape But Blockworld
description: You need to escape from the Squid competition, but while running away, you fell into the Block world. It’s a bit hard to escape from the Block world, but don’t stop and keep running. Never stop running until you reach the purple portal. Don’t forget to collect the money you see on the way. Be careful of the big monsters chasing you from behind; they want to catch you, and if they do, you’ll lose.

title: Squad Assembler
description:
Assemble a cool squad and see who wins!
Combine items to improve the fighters' equipment! Combine weapons and armor, buy loot boxes with new weapons!
You can create cool, unique characters, each of which will have certain skills! Buy parts for your fighters, change their arms, torso, head! Create real cyborgs to defeat the enemy! Merge armor and weapons, increase the levels and characteristics of items. Hire cool heroes who will help you in tough battles.

title: Goon Ball
description: Fast-paced, two-player game where players try to control a "Goon Ball" to paint the  floor their color before time runs out.

title: Block Mania
description: Block Mania: Mixing classic block and jigsaw puzzles, it’s a burst of creativity into beloved games! With easy controls, immersive sound effects, and a catchy beat, Block Mania guarantees addictive fun!

title: Flick Baseball Super Homerun
description:
Experience various baseball pitches based on the pendulum movement. The ball will fly further if you can hit the ball directly with the quick flick. Experience a “real-life like” batting simulation in this baseball game.
# One Flick Easy Control
You only use flick to control the batting for this game. The more accurate you flick your finger to hit the ball; it is more likely that you will be a home-run hitter.

title: Labubu Merge
description:
Engage, Merge, and Challenge!
Dive into a labubu-matching journey where you collide identical labubu to evolve them and keep them from falling out of the box. But here's the twist: when the same labubus collide, they transform into an entirely new labubu. Can you merge your way to the grand labubu?

title: Stunt Multiplayer Arena
description:
Go solo in a free roam challenge where you can pull off incredible stunts like front and backflips. Navigate icy and dirt tracks as you push various vehicles to their limits.

In the multiplayer derby mode, choose your vehicle—whether it's a car, truck, or van—and engage in a fierce survival derby. Compete against all other vehicles in an intense, smashing battle. 

Jump into the action today and see if you have what it takes to rule the arena!

title: Mahjong 3D Match
description: Welcome to the 3D Mahjong adventure! Challenge your mind with speed and precision. Plan your moves, view the board from all angles and remove pieces intelligently. Beat increasingly difficult levels, play offline and relax with immersive music.

title: Tsunami Race
description: Have you ever faced the thrill of escaping a giant tsunami? In this action-packed game, you’ll choose from a variety of unique characters and race to stay ahead of your opponents. The game offers three exciting modes: outrun a tsunami in Tsunami Race, dodge flying fruits in Fruit Run, and slide to glory in Water Slides—knocking down opponents and collecting boosters along the way. Only the fastest and most strategic players will emerge as champions!

title: Crazy Hill Climbing
description:
Get ready for the ultimate hill racing adventure in Crazy Hill Climbing! Race through steep hills, rugged terrains, and tackle challenging obstacles. With 15 unique levels and cars to unlock, upgrade your vehicles and customize your rides as you strive to conquer each track and perform daring stunts.

* Use coins to upgrade your engine, tires, suspension, and more to improve performance on rough terrains
* Execute daring front flips and back flips to earn extra points and boost your score

title: The Roman Empire Colosseum
description: The war in the colosseum has never been as epic as in this game! Arrange your units and send them into battle! This online game is a battle simulator similar to Totally Accurate Battle Simulator. Your units include warriors, riders, titans, dwarves, mages, and more.

title: Darts Master:Cartoon 3D
description: Dear dart experts and those who want to become dart experts. Please showcase your talents to the fullest on this thrilling dart journey. Collect and enrich your dart warehouse with the goal of overcoming all challenges. Experience the joy of different dart competitions.

title: Dragon Egg
description: Players can unlock higher-level Divine Dragon eggs by moving three or more of them. Supports multi-level recursive synthesis of 5-color dragon eggs. Eventually, unlocking high-level dragon eggs can unlock the birth of new dragons, accompanied by splendid animations, filling the sense of achievement to the fullest.

title: Bottle Logic
description: Bottle Logic is a satisfying drag-and-drop puzzle where you move and organize bottles into the correct places with smooth, intuitive controls. Enjoy 500+ handcrafted levels that steadily increase in challenge—providing the perfect daily brain cardio—plus an endless mode for non-stop play. Perfect for quick sessions or long relaxing runs, this game is designed for puzzle lovers who enjoy strategic thinking and clean, minimalist visuals.

title: Jungle Match Adventures
description: Jungle Match Adventures is a brand-new Match-3 game set deep in the lush Amazon Rainforest. Join the fearless explorer Aria as she uncovers hidden treasures, ancient relics, and precious gems buried in the jungle. Match colorful stones and nature-themed items, solve fun and challenging puzzles, and unlock secrets along the way. Take part in Daily and Weekly Challenges, enjoy Daily Surprises, and progress through hundreds of exciting levels in this unforgettable jungle adventure.

title: Obby Rescue Pin
description:
Obby Rescue Pin is a brain-burning, high IQ puzzle game that is especially addictive. How you pull the pins to rescue the Obby depends entirely on your logic and strategy!
Avoid Dangers: Navigate around bombs, ferocious animals, and deadly traps.
Outsmart the Room: Unlike simple rope rescue games, this experience focuses more on strategic adventures.
Help the Escape: Clear the path to help the Obby escape out of the dangerous room.

title: Happy Egg Catch
description:
Happy Egg Catch is a fun and colorful arcade skill game where timing and precision are the key to victory!

Eggs are hanging from the top and swinging back and forth. Your goal is simple: tap at the perfect moment to release the egg and land it safely inside the basket below. But be careful, the basket moves to different positions every round, so you must aim your throw carefully!

Test your reflexes, master the swing timing, and see how many eggs you can catch in a row!

title: Gas Station - Stick Simulator
description: You start with a small gas station in the middle of the highway, where everything depends on you. Service cars, fill up with gas, earn coins, and build even bigger! Over time, your gas station will grow into a true empire: with a store, restroom, cafe, and even a hot dog delivery service. The more customers, the more profit, upgrades, and fun!

title: Stack Tower Pro
description: Test your precision in this addictive 3D block stacking game! Build the tallest skyscraper, unlock stunning themes, and master the art of balance. Can you reach the stars?

title: Sprunki Shooter 2025
description: Sprunki Shooter 2025 is a free to play online game that delivers exciting shooting action in a colorful and challenging world. Players must navigate through each level, clearing obstacles and defeating enemies to reach the exit. The goal is to complete all levels by unlocking the exit doors. To do this, players must shoot and collect all the scattered diamonds while avoiding or eliminating dangerous enemies along the way. Have fun!

title: Color Race Obby
description: Color Race Obby is an exciting game inspired by Roblox and Obby. Compete with players online on a field of colored blocks. Enter the race and become the champion! Join the fun!

title: 3D Chess Master
description: 3D Chess Master – The ultimate 3D chess experience! Enjoy stunning three-dimensional graphics while testing your strategy skills. Challenge your friends in head-to-head matches or take on powerful AI opponents in the most immersive chess game yet.

title: Just Dice - Random Tower Defence
description: ? Welcome to "Just Dice: Random Tower Defense"! Get ready to roll the dice and defend your territory against hordes of relentless monsters in this exciting tower defense game. With a unique merging mechanic and vibrant visuals, you'll be hooked from the very first roll!

title: Plants Vs Zombies War
description: Plants Vs Zombies War is based on the famous PC game called Plants VS Zombies. This tower-defense strategy game needs your plans to fight against 15 kinds of incoming zombies. You can check the consumption and attack of all of your 15 plants before the battle. Then the tutorial will show the basic rules and plants at Level 1. The more levels you complete, the more plants you can unlock. You could also unlock them from ads in advance.

title: Soft Girls Winter Aesthetics
description: Hop on a plane and spend your winter vacation traveling around the world together with your favorite princesses. Discover fun winter activities and practice your fashion advisor skills while helping them choose their outfits of the day in the Soft Girls Winter Aesthetics for girls! Have a blast!

title: Ropeway Master
description:
Ropeway Master is a new challenging puzzle game. You should utilize the rope to free everyone,control the rope, overcome the obstacles, and complete the demanding and unique puzzle game. The
game is not difficult! Drag the rope to make a safe path, control the rope, and rescue everyone.Don't forget to avoid the obstacles along the way. If you play Rope Puzzle, make sure you do nothing. You will play for hours and linger.

title: Water Shooter
description: Welcome to the 'Water Shooter'! In this exciting first-person shooter game, you will find yourself in the role of a young hero who received a water pistol as a gift. Armed with this reliable weapon, you boldly go to the dungeon, where battles with fiery monsters await you. Immerse yourself in a fascinating world of adventures, explore mysterious corners and show everyone that your water trunk has the power of victory over fire!

title: Arrow Puzzle
description: Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

title: Dirty Money The Rich Get Rich
description: Dirty Money: The Rich Get Rich is a money clicker relaxation game. You are permitted to make money by tapping. When you earn some money and level up on the corresponding level, you can speed up by upgrading in the Growth, using the Invest, and making the Assets. The more money you make, the more functions you can unlock and use. I hope you will complete the target and make 100 million!

title: Addiction Solitaire
description: A classic solitaire game using the full deck, featuring two difficulty modes: EASY and HARD. Enjoy polished animations and an intuitive card placement system that makes gameplay smooth and satisfying.

title: Pool Duel
description: Keep your focus sharp as the clock ticks down, knowing that timing and precision will lead you to victory. Master your aim and cue control, because flawless execution and smart strategy separate true champions from the rest in every challenging match.

title: Office Knight 3D: Castle Defense
description:
Office Warrior: Wield swords and axes as skillfully as a stapler!
Action Battles: Fight various enemies in dynamic 3D environments.
Progression System: Level up, improve health and damage right in the heat of battle.
Weapon & Upgrade Shop: Collect coins to buy hero upgrades and equip yourself.
Endless Challenge: Deflect waves of enemies and prove you are the ultimate defender!

title: Brawl Stars
description: Welcome to a multiplayer arena game! Brawl Stars will take you into a world full of action .io battles! You will experience nervous PVP battles and a unique evolution system. Choose your favorite hero including fire dragons, electric dogs or flower spirits.

title: Best Friends Puzzle
description: Hop on an epic adventure with the Bug Heroes and help them defeat the menacing birds of the forest! Strategically link at least three symbols of the same colour to empower the Heroes with their special perks. Explore the lush green forests with your bug friends.

title: Sniper Team 3
description:
Take down waves of enemies using powerful sniper rifles in this action packed shooting game.

Sniper Team 3 is a sniper shooting game where you have to defeat enemy forces with the fire power of your whole team. The missions are a true challenge even for veteran snipers. 

Switch between your team members in real time, and make good use of your scoped rifles, heavy assault weapons and tactical airstrikes.

title: 2048 Merge World
description: The numbers are multiplying and the board is filling up. It's up to you to manage the chaos! Think quickly, act strategically and merge numbers to create bigger and better values. Be smart, but don’t forget to trust your intuition when making moves on the board.

title: Run 3D
description: The infinite running platformer game Run 3D takes place in the immensity of space. The character must be navigated by players through the constantly shifting space. Go, leap, and keep yourself from plummeting into the chasm!

title: Stickman Miners Wars
description: Lead your stickman king to victory in Stickman Miners Wars, where strategic decision-making is key. Command an army of miners and warriors to build your forces and triumph over opponents. Upgrade your units and yourself as you gain experience, and strategically attack enemy castles while defending your own. Will your strategy lead you to dominance? Play Stickman Miners Wars now!

title: Block Stacking
description: Block Stacking is a very fun, leisure, and pressure-relieving game. The game is very delicate and fresh. In the game, you will play by combining many different fruits. As long as you can complete the target tasks, you will have a chance to get rewards! By eliminating the fruits on the screen, you can successfully pass the level. It's extremely easy to operate, which makes you feel very addicted. Come and try the game!

title: Aloha Mahjong
description: Collect all the Hawaiian items in this daily Mahjong at Home game. Try to clear all tiles by pairing the same free Aloha tiles. A tile is free if it is not covered and has at least one free side.

title: Fix Da Brainrot
description: Fix Da Brainrot is a quirky jigsaw puzzle game with pieces that look like torn paper. Pick your challenge —16 pieces for a quick and easy fix or 32 pieces for a real brain teaser. Drag, drop, and fit the torn pieces together, and watch the picture slowly come alive as you fix the brainrot and conquer the puzzle!

title: Dark Myth: Monkey Merge
description: Merge warriors, build your army, and fight through hordes of monsters as the Monkey King! Your master and companions have been captured — combine strategy and action to rescue them all. From Common to Legendary, every merge makes you stronger.

title: Sweetsu Tile Puzzle
description: Sweet Tile Puzzle is a relaxing yet strategic game. Match 3 identical Japanese-themed tiles by drawing them into a limited stack. Clear the board by collecting all tiles while managing space wisely. With each level, challenges grow as the stack shrinks and more tiles appear. Can you master the art of tile matching?

title: Geometry Vibes X-Ball
description:
Geometry Vibes X-Ball is ready to give you a completely different gaming experience! After the first game of the series, interactive new levels, challenge section and completely new store are waiting for you in X-Ball mode. 

Start your new adventure now in Geometry Vibes X-Ball game where you will find yourself avoiding obstacles, traps and gears in each level!

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker is your ultimate creative escape into the world of anime character design. Craft stunning anime couples with romantic flair, dress up stylish girl avatars, and mix and match accessories, hairstyles, and outfits. With relaxing ASMR touches and a vibrant anime art style, this avatar creator lets your imagination shine in every love-filled duo you design.

title: Cornhole League - Board Games
description: Cornhole League is a thrilling twist on the classic backyard game where you aim, toss, and score your way to victory. Compete in intense matches, join tournaments, and showcase your flair with customizable boards and bags. Explore stunning venues, from cozy backyards to grand stadiums. Perfect your toss and rise to cornhole greatness!

title: Obby Massive Attack
description:
Help the Obby blox friends to rescue the hapless citizens of a city. During the adventure, you'll get bonuses that give you superpowers that will allow you to sweep aside everything in your path.
Obby Masive Attack is the ideal game for anyone who loves the running game genre. This time, Obby and friends are the protagonist - the game offers fast gameplay, nice graphics, special effects and good playability.
Collect coin and buy new power ups, and run forever in this fantastic endless adventure.

title: Puppy Merge
description: Puppy Merge is a unique merge game where you must grab and combine identical puppies to create a new and bigger one. Puppies will fall automatically into the arena; what you must do is drag the puppies around and merge them into identical ones. Don't let the puppies fall outside the box, or the game will end. You can try to catch the puppy and bring it back to the arena if the puppy falls.

title: Clay Craft Tycoon
description: Clay Craft Tycoon is a fun factory management game where you build and grow your own clay production business. Process raw clay, craft products like pots, plates, and cups, store them in your warehouse, and sell to outside markets. Complete daily tasks, earn cash at every stage, and expand your factory with new production units to become the ultimate clay tycoon!

title: Puzzle Blocks
description:
Race against time in tense speed battles, employ tactical thinking in rescue missions, and unwind by creating massive structures in free-play mode. Hone your skills assembling perfect puzzles or challenge the ever-accelerating chaos.

Puzzle Blocks is more than a game; it's a curated collection of perfectly crafted puzzles for any mood. The world of puzzles awaits its hero. Can you conquer every challenge?

title: Minicraft Chef Cake Wars
description: Hey player, would you like to have a cooking competition with your friend? In this cooking contest, you must beat your friend. Collect all the cooking materials as quickly as possible. We need to gather the cake ingredients floating in balloons in the air. The player who collects the most ingredients the fastest wins the game. To bake the cake, collect everything: salt, flour, and milk. Gather all the ingredients and win the game!

title: Practice On Me
description: Get ready for a glamorous summer adventure with Practice On Me, the ultimate makeup game! Transform into a festival goddess, beach babe, or blooming flower child in three exciting themed units. Grab your brushes, swipe on lipstick, and let your inner artist shine. Dance at festivals, relax by the beach or embrace nature's beauty. With Practice On Me, the possibilities are endless. Make waves, channel your inner mermaid, and bloom like a flower. Experience a summer adventure like no other!

title: Rocket Sky!
description: In Rocket Sky! you tap and hold the screen to launch your rocket as far into the sky as you can. Make sure not to overheat though, otherwise it’s game over!

title: Minicraft Winterblock
description: Winter has arrived, and everything is covered in snow. In the snow-covered forest, you must be very careful to survive. You need to find two chests and collect all the snowballs. But be cautious, there are monsters everywhere waiting to eat you. You must defeat the monsters and reach the hidden portal at the end of the level. You must leave the house safely and pass through the portal.

title: Academy Assault
description: Cael has decided to challenge Rin, the strongest in the academy that he goes to. She will only accept his challenge after he has defeated the other students in Imperium Academy.

title: Turbo Race 3D
description: Get ready for intense action in Turbo Race 3D! Upgrade your car’s speed, acceleration, grip, and brakes to dominate the competition. Use shields and boosters to gain an edge, and customize your ride with decals and colors. Race through 3 exciting worlds—city, desert, and snow—while evading traffic and outpacing opponents on thrilling highways. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate racer?

title: Traitor Beaver!
description: Beaver Traitor! An exciting game where one player takes on the role of the traitor, while the other players act as regular participants. Your goal as the traitor is to secretly kill all the other players, sabotaging their tasks at the nuclear power plant. You'll need to be cunning, careful, and think strategically to avoid detection and achieve victory. Use various tactics and deception to reach your goals.

title: Jigsaw Fantasy
description: Jigsaw Fantasy is the perfect game for puzzle lovers! Choose from a wide collection of puzzles, each offering a relaxing and fun experience. Want a personal touch? Upload your family photos and turn them into custom puzzles. Simply drag and drop the scattered pieces into place to complete the image. With intuitive controls and a clean interface, Jigsaw Fantasy is great for kids and adults alike.

title: Stickman Fight Pro
description: Stickman Fight Pro is an action-packed, fast-paced fighting game featuring simple yet intense gameplay. Players control a stickman character in a variety of challenging arenas, engaging in battles against other stickmen or AI opponents. The game emphasizes quick reflexes, strategic moves, and a variety of weapons and power-ups to outmaneuver and defeat enemies.

title: Vortex Ball
description: Roll through an ever-changing, vibrant tunnel filled with deadly obstacles and tricky hurdles. Test your reflexes as you dodge, weave, and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced infinite runner. Collect gems along the way and unlock 27 unique balls from the shop. With only 2 balls to start, every gem counts. The tunnel never ends, the colors keep shifting, and the challenge only gets harder. How far can you go? Compete for the highest score and prove your skills!

title: Transformers Battle For The City
description:
In this game you will find an open world where you will defend the city from the invasion of robots. If you are a fan of transformers, then you will definitely like this game. 
In the game you will find 7 full-fledged story tasks, the complexity of which will gradually increase. After receiving the task, you will go to the place of military operations, where you can use various super-techniques to destroy powerful robot villains.

title: School Teacher Game School Day
description: Enter the world of teaching in School Teacher Simulator! Manage classrooms, inspire students, and experience the daily challenges of education. Plan lessons, grade assignments, and engage with students to create a dynamic learning environment. Customize your teaching style and watch as your students grow and learn. Are you ready to become the ultimate educator?

title: Puzzle Games: Outing Day
description: Welcome to Puzzle Game: Outing Day, a casual puzzle game online. Today is the day for an outing. What will happen with all the little animals? What activities will they have on their trip to the field? Come and explore the interesting things on the camp and solve puzzles with your animal partners. See if you are the cleverest child in the crowd!

title: Nugget Man Survival Puzzle
description: Are you ready for adventure with the Nugget man character? To save the Nugget Man character who is stranded in the desert, you must fly into the sky without bursting the balloons. You must be careful to take the character to the finish by solving the puzzles before time runs out, accompanied by Gedagedago music. Rescue Nugget Man through desert bandits, cacti and many other challenging obstacles! Enjoy.

title: Noob Village Tower Defense
description: Dive into the dynamic world of a 2D platformer, where you play as a noob fighting for the survival of your village! Your main goal is to protect the village from endless waves of monsters appearing from an ominous portal. Control the tower manually: select shells, adjust the trajectory and shoot enemies one by one. Only your accuracy and tactics will help you survive the onslaught!

title: Fun Town Parking
description: Funtown Parking is an exciting parking simulation game where you must follow paths and park in designated spots while avoiding obstacles and challenges. As the levels progress, the routes become more complex, testing your precision and driving skills. Can you navigate through the chaos and park without a scratch? Take on the challenge and master every level!

title: Dogs vs Aliens
description: Your favorite pets have been kidnapped by evil aliens! Hurry to save them and punish the alien bullies. Evolve to defeat stronger enemies, free new dogs, get unique resources so that your dogs can evolve! Collect all the dog breeds and see how cool they will be! Discover new territories, visit the beach, park, city square and forest!

title: Dream Kitchen
description: Dream Kitchen is a fun and fast-paced restaurant simulation game inspired by shawarma-style cooking gameplay. Take customer orders, cook the right food, and serve every dish on time to keep customers happy. Complete levels with 3-star ratings, earn coins, upgrade your kitchen equipment, and unlock new recipes. Explore multiple themed chapters, including a Pancake Shop, Street Stall, Fast Food Restaurant, and Western Restaurant, each with unique dishes and challenges!

title: Tap 3D Blocks
description: Layers upon layers of dice await your skillful touch. Some puzzles ask you to think. This one dares you to see the whole picture. Flip, rotate and reveal new tiles as you uncover unexpected paths. Boosters lend a hand, but the strategy is all yours.

title: Shopaholic Black Friday
description: Experience fashion fun like never before with the Shopaholic Black Friday game! Navigate through makeup products, and indulge in chic fashion pieces. Hit the mall, shop as many items as you can before the time runs out, and then return for another styling adventure. Explore an array of lipstick hues, experiment with smoky eyes, or go for colorful shadows, and browse through fashionable dresses, trendy tops, and stylish shoes. Complete the look with dazzling accessories and designer bags.

title: Cars Derby Arena
description: Welcome to the world of Car Derby Arena! In this exciting game you can enjoy the unique experience of changing the color of cars, improving their performance, and manipulating gravity and weather conditions. Your goal is to become an invincible master of destruction, pump up your car and crush everything in your path. Embark on exciting missions, compete with other players and prove your skills in this epic Car Derby Arena game!

title: Fish Kingdom
description: Our game will show you in all the beauty of the real sea world. A world in which life is booming, because it is inhabited by sea creatures, mermaids, shells, plankton and many other amazing creatures of the sea world!

title: Revoxel 3D - Voxel RPG Shooter
description: Immerse yourself in a dynamic voxel-style RPG shooter with a cyberpunk atmosphere. A dark futuristic city overrun by a tech corporation awaits you, along with endless battles with robots and monsters, character development, and constant action in the spirit of a shooter RPG.

title: Dynamons 9
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 9! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Halloween world and the bonus cave.

Encounter Tholanyx, Scarykin, Anubolt, Sauryx in frankenstein skin, Zonysus in Dracula skin and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Italian Brainrot: Neuro Beasts
description:
Welcome to the world of Italian Neuro-Animals!
This is a clicker game featuring bizarre creatures generated by neural networks — get ready for chaos, memes, and pizza.

Collect them all! Level up like crazy! And may the Neuro-Pizza be with you

title: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker
description: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker is a fast, satisfying idle clicker built around one of the internet’s newest chaotic obsessions: the “Goo Goo Gaga” meme. Goo Goo Gaga Clicker takes the addictive, dopamine-fueled mechanics of Brainrot Clicker and gives them a surreal makeover.  What starts as a simple tap session quickly turns into a full-on collection grind where every click pushes you closer to the next weird, iconic form!

title: Dragon Draw Joust
description: Prepare for a wildly creative showdown in Dragon Draw Joust, where your imagination becomes your strongest weapon! Instead of choosing gear from a menu, you must draw your own tools to defend your warrior and survive intense combat challenges. Every match feels fresh because your strategy starts with your creativity. Your creation instantly becomes part of your character, helping you block attacks or strike opponents inside the chaotic battle arena.

title: Jelly Math 3D
description: Play Jelly Math 3D free online and explore a colorful browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Solve addition and subtraction, discover shapes, and tackle each logic puzzle in a playful 3D brain game designed for curious minds. This unblocked game loads fast and runs smoothly at school or home. Fully mobile-friendly and built for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game that turns learning into quick, fun, skill-boosting play anytime.

title: Worm Escape
description:
Worm Escape is a fun puzzle game that tests your logic and decision-making skills. Move worms in the correct order to clear each level. A single right move can solve the puzzle, while a wrong one can block your progress.

As you advance, levels become more complex with tighter spaces and more worms. Analyze carefully and choose the right sequence to succeed.

Simple tap controls make it easy to play, but mastering each level requires planning and strategy.

title: Cube in Cube
description: Play the new 2048 game with unique mechanics! Develop strategies to clear cubes in endless mode or rescue the monkey. Challenge yourself now!

title: Float for Brainrots
description: Float for Brainrots is a chaotic water adventure game where you collect rare Brainrots across dangerous seas. Start with a simple raft, unlock powerful boats, upgrade speed and capacity, and explore deeper waters for better rewards. Manage your timer, avoid sharks, and use islands to survive. Play solo or with a friend in 2 player mode and build your ultimate Brainrot collection.

title: Cube Stories: Escape
description:
Immerse yourself in a fascinating plot and follow a brave video blogger who bravely goes into the dark embrace of an abandoned mansion. As you make your way through each carefully designed room, you'll encounter a series of cryptic puzzles and mind-bending challenges that will test your intelligence, observation, and creative thinking.
As the plot develops, you will be plunged into the darkness of the house's past and the mysterious history of its former inhabitants.

title: Steam Sorter
description: Take control of a cute robot and get to work sorting industrial garbage! A dynamic puzzle game with a steampunk aesthetic.

title: Ninja Obby Parkour
description:
Step into the thrilling world of Ninja Obby Parkour, where every level is a test of speed, agility, and strategy. Packed with hundreds of unique obstacle courses, this game combines competitive racing with ninja-style combat and dazzling customization options.

From smashing glass doors at checkpoints with your ninja power to unlocking powerful bonuses like speed boost, giant mode, and flight, every run feels fresh.

title: Sky Balls 3D
description: Sky Balls 3D invites you on an adventure as you travel through the sky with rolling balls and test your reaction skills. Keep the ball on the track without letting it fall and watch out for obstacles, traps and gaps! Collect coins and keys along the way to get new ball skins and sky-boxes. You can play the game in 1 player and 2 player modes.

title: Us Army Car Games Truck Driving
description: Army truck 3d simulator is a realistic military game in which they supply their weapons, foods also use them for the transportation of troops for war and to protect their city from terrorist attacks. Are you looking forward to have an amazing modern army truck driver game to drive your army vehicle and become an army machines driver, as much as you want.

title: Block Escape
description: Block Escape is a brain-teasing puzzle game where players clear blocks by moving them off the screen in the direction shown by the arrows on each block. Each level requires logical thinking and careful planning, as blocks can only move in specific directions, making every puzzle increasingly challenging and strategic.

title: Table Tennis Open
description: Discover a casual, easy-to-play game for hours of endless fun. Face off against your opponent, bounce the ball as its speed increases, and aim for the highest score. Earn coins with each hit to upgrade your racket!

title: Mineblock Obby
description: Minecraft Obby is an amazing parkour game that you can play totally free! Do your best as you navigate through challenging obstacle courses, avoiding pitfalls and traps along the way. Collect coins scattered throughout each level to buy yourself a new sword and enhance your gameplay experience. With each jump and sprint, you'll improve your skills and push your limits. Dive into the blocky world of Minecraft Obby, avoid obstacles, collect those coins, and most importantly—have fun!

title: Smoke Trail
description:
Drift and earn in this fast-paced 2D endless drifting game!
Master the art of controlled slides across an ever-changing track. Rack up cash by chaining stylish drifts and maintaining momentum—then use your earnings to unlock a growing collection of iconic drift cars, each with its own unique stats and feel. But it’s not just about the money—complete challenges to test your skill, and unlock a special car.

Easy to pick up, hard to master—how far can you go before you crash?

title: Dungeon Master – Cult & Craft
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a mysterious dungeon, where you are its keeper and master! Turn simple stickmen into devoted followers capable of mining ore and creating value for your dark empire. Develop the Cult, manage resources and expand the boundaries of your underground Universe!

title: Idle Lunch
description: Idle Lunch is a fun and casual idle game where your mission is to take big bites and earn coins! Start your journey with a simple burger, tapping to take each bite and build your fortune. As you accumulate coins, unlock new delicious foods to keep the fun going, from pizzas to fancy desserts. The more you bite, the more you earn! Invest your coins in powerful upgrades that boost your earnings, allowing you to munch faster and grow your wealth even quicker.

title: Hole Eat Grow Attack
description:
Eat objects, and ammos, and attack other holes around. Two unique game modes, time attack and infinite modes are waiting for you. Let your hole battle begin in the arena against the other holes.

The game consists of two levels Time Attack and Infinite. There are more than 20 characters. You can play the game either in single-player mode or in 2 player mode. Pick your hole fighter and start the game. You can activate player 2 with keys. Make sure you avoid larger-hole enemies around.

title: Clinic Cleanup Crew
description:
Players play the role of cleaners in the health center in the game. They are responsible for the cleaning and sanitation work in all areas within the health center, keeping the environment of the health center clean and hygienic and providing a good environment for clients.
The game features a fresh and lovely art style, with the details of characters and buildings depicted vividly, bringing players a healing visual enjoyment.

title: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw
description: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw is a funny puzzle game with the most popular meme characters. You can select one of the fifteen images and then select one of the four modes (16, 36, 64 and 100 pieces). Select your favorite picture and complete the jigsaw in the shortest time possible! Have fun and enjoy!

title: Ghostly Graveyard Halloween Special
description:
This Halloween, experience the thrill of Ghostly Graveyard is a spooky platformer adventure where you explore a haunted graveyard and unravel its mysteries. Navigate challenging levels, collect coins, and avoid ghostly encounters. Can you solve the graveyard's secrets?
A Halloween Special Spooky Puzzle Adventure.

title: Fly Fly Fly
description:
Fly Fly Fly is a Flappy Bird alike game, where you have to fly through 30 different levels, avoiding obstacles an collecting berries. 
If you hit the ground it will be game over, if you crash on one of the earth worms around the level, you will lose a life. If you lost all your lives, it's game over. You can restore your health collecting the berries you will find around the level. Do your best and beat all the 30 levels and show the world what you really are!

title: Gun Shooting Range
description: In this game, you are a rookie sniper at the beginning, take your rifle, pass all the missions,and grow into a professional sniper! Remember, shoot every bullet calmly, be accurate and fatal,and use the least bullets to do the biggest damage.

title: SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY
description:
SPRUNKI GETS SURGERY ??

OREN, a genius (but reckless) surgeon, must save PINKI after a brutal facial injury—without anesthesia! As more SPRUNKIS like TUNNER, shot in the head, flood the ER, OREN races against time. But lurking in the shadows is BLACK, ready to turn OREN’s mission into a nightmare. Will OREN save them all, or will BLACK end it in tragedy?

title: Portals
description: Portals - HTML5 adventure-puzzle game where two heroes, one black and one white, are stranded on a mysterious planet filled with portals after being swallowed by a black hole. Your mission is to guide them through a series of challenging levels, utilizing their unique abilities to navigate this portal-filled world and find their way home. With intriguing puzzles, captivating graphics, and an immersive storyline, Portals offers a thrilling gaming experience for players of all ages.

title: Relaxing cubes and campfire
description: A relaxing and peaceful game with delightful campfire sounds! You can easily learn how to play and win - just place blocks to create and remove vertical and horizontal lines. The game is suitable for all ages.

title: Tap Car
description:
Unveil stunning car masterpieces by solving image puzzles. Every tap reveals more of the picture—can you uncover them all? A must-play for car enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike!

Would you like a few more variations depending on the tone you're aiming for (like more casual, exciting, or elegant)?

title: Home Block Story
description: Step into a world of renovation! Match blocks, clear the board and unlock new decor to design your house just the way you want. With each new challenge, show your unique style and make your dream home a reality.

title: Hit Knock Down
description: Hit & Knock Down is a fun casual game where you aim to throw baseballs. Shoot as many targets as possible. Test your precision, reaction speed, and throwing skills. You aim to hit the right targets in each level. The goals at the level are very varied, such as wood, stone, etc. Each level presents different targets. You should hit with a baseball.

title: Mahjong Triple 3D Tile Match
description: Jump into a fresh and relaxing brain challenge with Mahjong Triple 3D - Tile Match, a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game that brings the classic mahjong experience into a colorful 3D world! In this game, the tiles are stacked in beautiful 3D shapes. Your goal is simple but satisfying: tap and collect three identical tiles to clear them from the board.

title: Animal Transform Race
description: Animal Transform Race is a fun game based on reaction where different types of animals compete. Each animal is fast in some areas and very slow in some tracks according to their abilities. Try to lead the race by making the right choices. The faster you make animal choices, the more advantages you gain. You can unlock new animals from the market section with the coins you earn from the races.

title: Power Light
description: Move the tiles around until the power can flow freely to the light bulb. Power up the light bulb to complete each level in this fun online puzzle game

title: Oreplication
description: Sandbox strategy tycoon where you design factories for infinite wealth. Start with basic droppers & conveyors, upgrade to advanced machines. Deep progression, mystery boxes, endless optimization—build, outsmart, ascend in the ultimate factory challenge!

title: Stickboys Hook
description: Swing with Stickboys and jump your way to the finish line. Stickboys needs your help. Assist him and reach the goal! Jump from launch ramps and shoot webs to get to the end. You must complete every level. Be careful — if you fall from the sky, you lose the game.

title: Toilet Pin
description: Join the daily story of the toilet boy in the monster letter world. This new pin pulling game is for you. Let's explore Alphabet Lore with extraordinary characters! In the land of evil letters, you will have a chance to meet various amazing characters and powers of them: evil B ready to punch in your face, Angry C biting with sharp teeth, boring F with a gun, Crazy Z with fire, monster D who loves lava ....

title: Football Penalty
description: Step into an exhilarating, never-ending penalty challenge! Show your opponents the power of your accurate shots and become a real football hero. Collect points for every target hit, progress through levels, and improve your football skills. Take part in a big tournament and get more rewards.

title: Daddy Cactus
description: Take control of a giant cactus with an unusual hunger for meat! Roam the colorful 3D world, collecting meat from unsuspecting humans and free chunks scattered across the map. As you gather more meat, your cargo will fill up, and once it’s full, you can deliver your haul to Mommy Cactus, who waits for your delicious deliveries. But be careful! The world is full of dangerous obstacles like cannons.

title: Monster School Challenge
description: Complete teacher's assignments for evaluation, finding out who is a Noob and who is a Pro! Different tests and characters are waiting for you in the game Monster School Challenge.

title: Rainbow Friends. Survival
description:
A fun and dangerous game about Rainbow Friends!
You are in a dangerous place. You need to survive 5 days and 5 nights, but the deadly obstacle will be the terrifying and bloodthirsty monsters Rainbow Friends!
Complete all the missions, move fast, perform actions carefully and run away from the monstrous monsters!

title: PacXon New Realms
description:
Lay hold of the land in PacXon New Realms, the long-awaited sequel to the 2007 
classic PacXon Deluxe. Explore 192 challenging levels across 4 different locations. 
Dodge enemies as you seize chunks of territory in this thrilling twist on the original 
arcade adventure.

Enjoy a revamped user interface, a fresh soundtrack, and nostalgic pixel art 
animations. Plus, unlock 4 - 6 unique character skins per location. Get ready for a 
captivating journey filled with new features and fun.

title: Rich Choice Run
description: Rich Choice Run is a fun swipe runner where every decision shapes your final lifestyle. Slide left and right to pick the best “boyfriend” choices and grab expensive items along the way. Your choices build your value and status—choose wisely, because one bad pick can ruin your chance.

title: Physics Balls
description: Physics Balls is a creative and challenging math and physics puzzle game. Here has numbers and ball elements. Improve your logical thinking and hands-on skills while having fun. Your aim is to break all bricks in one shoot. Throw balls to make them roll among the bricks. You can apply physical principles to control the balls cleverly.

title: Sunny Link
description: 'Sunny Link' is an easy and fun game where players match tiles with summer icons. The goal is to connect two identical tiles. Tiles can be linked if you can join them with three or fewer straight lines. The game has many levels to enjoy. As you play, you’ll hear sounds of the sea. It’s perfect for relaxing and having fun in the sun!

title: Magic Finger Puzzle 3d
description:
Magic Finger Puzzle 3D is an interesting casual puzzle online game. You have an amazing pair of  hands that can fire the laser. It can help you smash the cages that are holding you. It can also
  launch boxes onto barricades so that you can escape from the cage without stepping on spikes and dying. But don't worry, you need to use your ingenuity to make good use of those amazing hands. All difficulties will be solved. Join the game if you want to try a journey full of adventure.

title: Mona Lisa Fashion Experiments
description: Welcome to a small humorous adventure in which you will try on the role of a stylist for the most mysterious lady of all time - Mona Lisa Gioconda. Connect the past and the present by mocking trends and memes. Each of your changes is a small work of art, and each outfit immediately causes fireworks of pleasant emotions. There is no framework here - only freedom of expression. And the variety of images is guaranteed to make your time in the game unforgettable!

title: My Cat Restaurant
description: Welcome to My Cat Restaurant, a casual kids cooking simulator game that you can play for free. Act as a chef and restaurant manager. Take orders, cook food, serve customers, and collect money. Plan your moves and workload in advance, and figure out an efficient routine.

title: Words with Owl
description: Test your spelling skills and word recognition in this fun and challenging game! Complete words by filling in the missing letters and aim for the highest score. Unlock exciting new stages as you progress and enjoy a rewarding wordplay experience.

title: CityMix Solitaire
description:
Play card games, relax and train your memory and brain with CityMix Solitaire. Solitaire CityMix is more than just another game♠♥♠♥!
Which would you prefer: decorating and restoring a quiet town, or solving puzzles and seeking adventure on a lost island? With CityMix Solitaire you can decorate, solve puzzles and mysteries, follow adventures and help brave heroes. Vicky and her pet Raccoon will help in this challenging quest.

title: Robot Transform Race
description: Robot Transform Race is a running arcade game that is made of collecting, avoiding, and transforming elements. With 3D transformable robots, you need to win each race by collecting useful items, avoiding obstacles, and slowing down the other robots. Mostly you can strike and slow down the other robots nearby. Collect missiles to attach the advanced robots behind you. Don't forget to design your robot rather than buying a provided skin.

title: Harbor Operator
description:
As the harbor master and operator, navigate incoming ships to the correct docks. Tap and drag to draw routes into the docks, while taking into account the unloading time, speed, and other visual indicators.

Control beautiful ships such as yachts, super yachts, container ships, oil tankers and more. Plan your routes to avoid any shipping accidents.

title: Math Master
description: Unleash your inner math whiz! Math Master turns numbers into art—solve fun math problems to unlock drawing tools, sketch colorful shapes, and bring numerical puzzles to life. Perfect for learners and creativity lovers alike!

title: Madness Cars Destroy
description:
The game features 6 unique modes:

Funnel: Push cars into the abyss as the funnel narrows!
Rotating Cube: Stay on the spinning cube, which speeds up over time!
Deadly Arena: Dodge falling bombs and collapsing floors—or shoot players instead!
Right Color: Inspired by Roblox, but with cars!
Deadly Bouncers: Avoid spinning mines in a gladiator-style arena!
Hot Potato: Pass the bomb or explode!
Choose from foreign or Russian cars and dive into the action!

title: Accurate 2D
Imposter Coloring Book
description: Get ready for a colorful twist on the mystery and excitement of the Imposter Coloring Book! Inspired by the thrilling world of imposters, this coloring app lets you bring your favorite characters to life with vibrant colors and unique brush styles. Choose from various brushes, including pastel, watercolor, and pencil, to add a unique touch to each crewmate, imposter, and spaceship scene. Whether you prefer bold colors or a soft pastel look, every coloring page is yours to make unique.

title: Magic Finger
description: Magic Finger 3D is a casual physics game where you use your magical powers to defeat alien foes creatively. Use your magic touch to throw enemies at each other, utilize explosive barrels for big impacts, and send adversaries off platforms. Control your surroundings by picking up and manipulating objects, becoming the ultimate magic user.

title: Kick Loser
description:
Dive into the world of Kick Loser, a puzzle game that challenges your creativity and problem-solving skills. The objective is simple—inflict maximum damage on the stickman hero using a variety of objects. Each object has unique properties, adding a strategic element to your gameplay.
Take aim and deliver powerful drags to send the stickman crashing into objects. Experiment with different angles and forces to achieve the most satisfying results.

title: Words from Words
description: "Words from Words" is an exciting game, the purpose of which is to create as many different words as possible from the letters given to you. You can create 29 words from the word «example», «maverick» includes 71 words, and "chalkboard" stores as many as 142 words. Can you solve everything?

title: Fashion Famous
description: Step into the stylish universe of Fashion Famous! Compete in glamorous fashion contests, pick outfits that match each round’s theme, and impress the judges to earn high scores. Travel across global fashion capitals and showcase your look on dazzling runways. Explore makeup, hairstyles, and accessories to build the perfect outfit. Will your sense of style stand out among players from all around the world?

title: Fill Glass
description:
Fill Glass is a simple yet addictive game. Fill the glass to the perfect level without letting it overflow or fall short of the target. Precision is key as you pour, aiming for the highest highscore!
As you progress, upgrade your pouring machine to enhance your accuracy!

title: Sea Match
description: See Match is a challenging match-3 puzzle game. Connect 3 or more of the same fishes horizontally or diagonally. The more fishes you match, the higher your score! Keep an eye on the time. You will fail to pass the level if you do not gather sufficient grids in time. The faster you complete the task, the more stars you earn! If you find yourself stuck, you can always use the special bonuses to help you.

title: SCP 173 Escape
description: Step into the role of SCP-173 and break free from the Foundation’s control in a tense stealth experience built around a deadly rule: you can MOVE only when no one is LOOKING at you. Hide in the shadows, avoid patrols, and choose the perfect moment to dash through dark corridors where every mistake leads to capture.

title: Princess Dress Up Run
description: Run, collect, and dress up like a true princess. Race around the fantasy track. Collect all kinds of gorgeous princess dresses, shoes and accessories along the way according to the goal. Create the perfect princess look. And watch out for obstacles and traps, such as suddenly broken platforms, flames, etc.

title: Italian Brainrot Drag Merge Puzzle
description: A Revolutionary Jigsaw Experience. Each level, one image is randomly selected and split into 3×3, 4×4, 5×5, or 6×6 pieces, then completely shuffled. Your goal is simple: restore the picture by placing every piece in its correct position. But this is no ordinary jigsaw. When two neighboring pieces are placed correctly next to each other, they merge into a single movable cluster. Instead of slow, one-by-one placement, you can drag any piece or merged group onto another to instantly swap positions.

title: Jungle Solitaire
description: Jungle Spider Solitaire is an adaptation of the classic card game Spider Solitaire with a jungle theme. It is optimized for short games and encourages strategic planning of moves with an original system of collecting diamonds.

title: Reversi
description: Challenge your strategic mind against the computer in difficulty levels from absolute novice to expert in this classic game of flipping disks.

title: Fill & Sort Puzzle
description: Fill & Sort Puzzle is a cozy puzzle game where players have to sort, stack, and pleasantlarrange household items while watching for a naughty cat who likes to make things messy!  Many small details need to be paid attention to in the levels. For example, when organizing the shoe rack, don’t forget to clean the dirty shoes before storing them. Do you need a hint? Watch the video for tips.

title: Slime Rush
description: Join the colorful adventure of *Slime Rush*! Control a lively group of slimes as you race along challenging paths, avoiding obstacles and growing your slimes. Collect gems to unlock unique skins and power-ups. Can you lead your slimes to victory? Start your journey in *Slime Rush* today!

title: Best Classic Freecell Solitaire
