description: A new family has just arrived in this town, and they're in desperate need of your assistance. This isn't just a helping hand mission; it's a home transformation and management simulator! You need to help them clean dust, clean the home, rearrange clothes, design the house, and repair damaged things.

title: Sworded.io - Spin and Rub.
description: Test your skills in the game – an arcade simulator of sword fights! Fight waves of enemies, upgrade your character, unlock powerful weapons and magic spells. Demonstrate your tactics and reaction in dynamic battles!

title: Kick and Ride
description: Kick and Ride is a physics-based puzzle game consisting of two game modes. Drag and drop the block to make path for the soccer as well as for the vehicle. Enjoy the vibrant and colorful beach themed game.

title: Purrfect Puzzle
description: Purrfect Puzzle is an adorable cat-themed tile-merging puzzle game where players strategically place and combine cat tiles with different values to achieve higher scores. With relaxing pastel visuals, the game challenges players to think ahead while enjoying a cozy, heartwarming experience. Perfect for puzzle lovers and cat enthusiasts alike!

title: Unpuzzle Master
description:
Unpuzzle master plan and execute your moves strategically to become the master, navigating through bottlenecks and utilizing “exit” strategies effectively.

Touch the tile to move it in the direction of the tile. Complete each level that really challenges your brain to think sharper.

Choose from a variety of themes and skins to customize your block-puzzle adventure. Each skin not only changes the visual aesthetic but also improves the way you interact with the puzzles, making every move count.

title: Spin Shot Siege
description: In "Spin Shot Siege," take control of a gunner on a rotating tower. Enemy tanks orbit around you in the opposite direction. Each level has tanks following paths like diamonds, circles, rectangles, or triangles. Aim carefully and destroy all tanks before running out of ammo. Can you master the spin and win the siege?

title: Darling Doll
description: Darling Doll is the ultimate paper doll DIY game that offers a perfect blend of character creation and dress-up game. With a vast collection of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles, you can unleash your creativity and design unique avatars that reflect your personal style. Whether you prefer chibi dolls or glamorous fashion dolls, Darling Doll has got you covered.

title: Tap & Go Deluxe
description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure in this arcade runner game! Your goal is simple: Tap to move forward or change direction. Navigate your way through the path, aiming for higher scores as you pave the way!

title: Alien Wreckage 1
description: In "Alien Wreckage - Chapter 1" you are a lone space traveler, who explore the deepspace looking for alien artifacts around the universe. Face alien creatures, collect coins and jewels to spend in the game shops, find all the secrets and unlock new powerups.

title: Capybara Go!
description: Enter the wonderful world of Capybara. In Capybara Go, begin a strategic adventure. You'll be forming and commanding your own little Capybara army. Defeat your opponents and conquer everything through strategy and combat. Lay out your Capybara's to take advantage of each one's strengths and use strategy to defeat powerful enemies.

title: Jailbreak Assault
description: In Jailbreak Assault, you’re a prisoner on a daring escape mission. Starting in your cell, you grab a key dropped by a guard, unlock the door, and arm yourself with a baton. Battle guards, destroy vital documents, disable cameras, and unlock new areas as you fight your way through each mission. Eventually, you’ll secure a gun from the armory, using it to take on the heavily guarded outer perimeter. Can you make it to freedom?

title: Mage's Secret
description: Combine monsters and increase your power by thinking every action. You have to meet monsters, complete more than 100 tasks and learn the secret of the magician.

title: Roof Car Stunt
description: Challenging car game where you drive and collect coins. Jump around ramps, drive through various obstacles and drive into a giant pink donut to complete the level!

title: Tile Match Cafe
description:
Discover the engaging tile-matching puzzle game that plunges you into a world of triple-tile tapping challenges and stimulating fun.

Prepare yourself for an exciting adventure filled with complex puzzles as you match tiles, clear the boards, and strive to become the top tile master.

With its intuitive mechanics and addictive gameplay, Tile Match Cafe is an ideal pick for fans of tile-matching games seeking a charming and rewarding puzzle experience.

title: i8 City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning supercar through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Bublix: Bubble Hit
description: Bublix: Bubble Hit is a fast-paced bubble shooter where precision and strategy matter. Aim, shoot, and match 3 or more bubbles to clear the board. Use clever angles, wall bounces, and combos to boost your score. With endless gameplay and rising difficulty, it’s perfect for quick, addictive sessions.

title: Dot by Dot
description:
Dot By Dot is a relaxing puzzle game where you have to connect dots into lines and get amazing drawings. Once you connect all the dots and lines, the drawing will be automatically colored! Enjoy the addictive puzzle game!
Let the Dot by Dot game develop your creativity and skills. Draw a line, connect colored dots and see what kind of drawing you get.

title: Black pink Black Friday Fever
description: Blackpink Black Friday Fever is a fun dress-up game designed for K-pop and Blackpink fans! Dive into the world of style by creating unique looks for Jisoo, Jennie, Rosé, and Lisa, inspired by Black Friday’s biggest fashion trends. As a fan, you’ll get to style each member of Blackpink with a range of outfits and accessories that perfectly suit their personalities.

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: Stickman Rocket
description: You have a powerful cannon loaded with Stickman Ragdols which you must shoot far to reach your target! Solve all kinds of challenges as you collect gems, avoid obstacles and control your throws to reach the targets in each level. Try not to bump into obstacles along the way and use all the raggedy characters you need to have fun with these amazing challenges - good luck!

title: My Farm
description: Become the proud owner of your very own farm! Grow crops, tend to animals, catch fish, and set up production. Assemble collections of exotic animals in the zoo, meet the mysterious visitors, and embark on thrilling adventures!

title: Bingo Halloween
description: A Halloween-themed bingo game where you can win exciting bingos to unlock spooky candy-themed images. Enjoy multiple call speeds and progressive unlocks.

title: Trading Games Playtime
description: Hey there, game lovers! Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with Trading Games Playtime, the ultimate casual game that's all about relaxation and non-stop fun! This game is a magical blend of various mini-games, making it a one-stop destination for your entertainment needs. First off, it doubles as a fantastic antistress simulator.

title: Toilet Rush
description: You have to help the boy and girl who want to go to the toilet to find their way. They should not encounter obstacles and their paths should not overlap while going to the toilet. You can achieve this by making drawings. You can get help from the "Hint" button when you have difficulty. Don't forget to try other "Skins" in the game.

title: Poppy Strike 5
description: Poppy Strike 5 is a first person shooter game with elements of horror where your mission is to use big arsenal of weapons to shoot huggy wuggy and kisiy misiy and find a way to escape liminal spaces of haunted toy factory.

title: Mine 2D Survival Herobrine
description:
"Mine 2D: Survival Herobrine" - a continuation of adventures, but no longer in prison, but in a world where you will have to survive together with noob!
You have a whole open world in front of you, where you can do anything you want: complete challenging tasks, mine and improve resources, and build grandiose constructions from blocks!  
Beware of Monsters: You will have to fight off monsters that want you dead. 
Herobrine: A frightening type who will try to scare you in every possible way!

title: Microplastics Feeding
description: Microplastics Feeding is a game about a hungry fish who is looking for its favorite food: plastic! Help the fish to eat all the plastic things in the ocean!

title: Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d
description: Roll your block across challenging 3D platforms and drop it into the goal hole to solve each puzzle. Bloxorz - Block Puzzle 3d is an addictive block puzzle game that tests your logic, spatial thinking, and problem-solving skills across dozens of mind-bending levels.

title: Treasure Hunt Puzzle
description: Explore ruins, complete stone tablet puzzles, and collect treasures! Solve each puzzle by fitting all your blocks into the board using the symbols as hints.

title: DayCare Tycoon
description: Are you ready to build your dream business empire and be a great babysitter in this money tycoon simulator ? From welcoming adorable babies to creating a safe and happy environment, this game offers everything you need to grow your daycare business into a successful venture.

title: Sniper Elite 3D
description: Prepare to enjoy the finest 3D sniper experience ever with the most thrilling and action-packed shooting game! Sniper 3D is the ultimate free gun game that immerses you in the life of a lethal assassin. Immerse yourself in high-intensity offline missions and test your shooting abilities in this adrenaline-fueled sniper experience. Have fun playing Sniper Elite 3D, a free online game!

title: Fish Feeding
description: Nobody can stop you, but you are not the only fish in the sea: you will have to avoid the vicious sharks that wander in the deepest, darkest depths, looking for a nice little fish to eat! See how high you can score!

title: Witchy and the Puzzle Adventures
description: Help the brave Witch to pass all the puzzling tests and find all the seals to shelter them in her cozy forest house. Kittens are lost in the forest, which is full of various traps and dangers, you need to help the Witch to pass all the tests and find all the seals.

title: Axe Throw
description:
Ready to test your precision? Welcome to Axe Throw, the ultimate test of aim and timing. The rules are simple, but the challenge is endless. You have one goal: Break the target.

But be careful—the path to victory is rigged with danger. Explosive bombs are moving, and blocking your way. One wrong move, and it's game over!

title: My Arcade Center 2
description:
My Arcade Center 2 is a fast-paced arcade management tycoon game.

Build, customize, and expand your own arcade across 7 unique maps. Earn by day, upgrade by night, unlock new machines, hire staff, optimize layouts, and grow your business. Switch between centers anytime, unlock new characters and skins, complete daily missions, and boost your long-term progress with rewarding upgrades.

title: Extreme Real Car Driving 2025
description: This ultimate car racing 3D lets you experience real car driving simulator like highway racing with its realistic car damage, accurate car driving physics and many other features. title: Domino Adventure
description: Discover three match durations to suit your style. Showcase your skills and logic in each round, and use strategic moves to outplay your opponents. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts seeking endless fun and challenges.

title: Mr Throw
description: Mr Throw is a game in which even an old teddy bear can become a deadly weapon! Calculate the strength and direction of the throw and throw at the enemy all the things that come to hand! Victory in this dangerous garbage battle!

title: Ultimate Plants TD
description: Ultimate Plants TD is an army of plants to protect your garden from countless zombies. Your goal is to protect your garden from challenging waves of zombies. Experimenting with different plant combinations and positioning is the key to maximizing your defense capabilities and overcoming tough challenges!

title: Slope Snowball
description: Slope SnowBall is an intriguing endless-running game with a winter theme. Your aim is to roll a snowball as far as possible down slopes full of hazards!

title: Dan the Man
description: With a cracking funny story, action, an awesome upgradeable fighting skills and an epic arsenal of weapons that will make even the most heroic of heroes envious, Dan The Man's arcade fight fest has enough enemies and boss fights to satisfy every hardcore Action Platformer enthusiast and every indie game lover.

title: Apocalypse Shelter
description: The world has fallen — but survival is still possible. Build and expand your shelter, manage resources, and create a safe haven in a hostile environment. Assemble a squad of unique heroes, each with their own abilities and combat style. Engage in tactical turn-based battles, plan your moves, and use your team’s skills to overcome dangerous enemies. Unlock new characters from chests, upgrade their cards, and build the ultimate squad to survive the apocalypse.

title: Chain Cube 2048 3D Merge Game
description:
Ready to challenge yourself? Chain Cubes 2048 is an addictive merging puzzle online game for those who like challenging brain teasers and logic puzzle merging games. Believe it or not, it's much
harder to put together 2048 cubes than it is to throw away the numbers. If you fail to merge the cube number blocks, they will bounce off each other!  Keep playing and eventually complete 2248 number puzzles!

title: Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle
description: Dive into the relaxing world of Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle! Your goal is simple: sort the colored liquids into the flasks until each flask contains only one color. With over 1000 levels and unique modes like Color Fusion, Mystery, and Time Trial, this puzzle game will test your logic and patience. Unlock new themes and achievements as you play!

title: Merge Master
description: A casual mobile game centered around matching and elimination. The game features vibrant colors, coupled with a visual style rich in beach elements. With background music and sound effects reminiscent of leisurely walks along the beach, it creates a relaxed beach-strolling environment that immerses players in an auditory experience.

title: Black Pink Christmas Concert
description: If you’re a fan of Black Pink, the Black Pink Christmas Concert Dress Up game is perfect for you. This game lets you style the members of Black Pink for their exciting holiday concert. Whether you’re a Black Pink fan or love fashion, this game offers endless styling options. Celebrate the magic of Christmas while showing off your creativity.

title: Crown & Cannon
description: Crown & Cannon is a fast-paced 2D strategy game where players expand territory, deploy various weapons, and battle dynamic AI on destructible terrain. It features upgradeable units, strategic combat, and is optimized for Web platforms and cross platform.

title: Helix Crush
description: "The gameplay is very simple and can be accomplished with only one finger, yet it will also bring you countless challenges and fun. You need to jump and fall through the helix tower, cutting through the colorful fruit and cake slices on the way. But be careful! There are many obstacles and traps along the way, and it will be up to your reflexes and luck to get through them.

title: Colors pins
description:
Someone has pinned a lot of pins, and you need to put them all away in boxes, and most importantly, make sure that the colors match!

Game Features:

A variety of levels
Colorful graphics
Relaxing gameplay

title: Princess Royal Wedding
description: Welcome to the princess Royal Wedding game. Princesses are getting ready for their wedding with Kristoff and Jack. They waiting so long for this occassion. They need some hand to get ready. Come and join the girls! And make this occassion most beautiful one in their life!

title: Magic Kingdom. Hex Match
description: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match is a game where you are the third son of a great king, sent to a distant land to prove your worth. Collect six vital resources—food, water, stone, wood, workers, and metal—to construct new buildings. Unlock all structures and create a stunning, magical kingdom!

title: Obby Tower
description:
Climb. Think. Survive.

Ascend a towering obstacle course filled with tricky jumps, moving platforms — and surprise math challenges! Combine your parkour skills with quick thinking to make it to the top.

Perfect for players who love obbies and want to test both reflexes and brainpower.

title: Snake 2048.io
description: Cubes are all around the arena and it is time to collect these cubes and merge them to have a longer 2048 cube snake! A great 2048 game begins with cube snakes and cubes in a huge arena. You will start with a low number of snakes, collect lower numbered cubes around the map, and try to make your snake bigger by combining numbers. Collect power-ups and give your snake more advantages.

title: Zombie Shooting King
description: The apocalypse is here! Hordes of zombies are swarming the streets. You are the last line of defense. Grab your gun, sharpen your shooting skills, and unleash unstoppable firepower to survive. Shoot fuel tanks, airdrops, and more to get more firepower to destroy tons of zombies. Get diamonds to upgrade your talents like Guardrail, ATK Boost, Crit Rate, or Coin earning!

title: Commando Force 2
description: Get ready for a gun games adventure with Commando Force 2! Jump into a fast-paced shooter! Join the fun and dive into the action! Unlock new weapons, dominate the maps, and show everyone what you’ve got!

title: Pizza Maker - Cooking Games For Kids
description: Become a pizza master by creating delicious pizzas from scratch with 15 unique recipes. Choose ingredients, slice vegetables, shred cheese, and prepare toppings. Knead and roll the dough, spread the sauce, add toppings, and bake. Once ready, box your pizza for delivery! Fun, engaging, and perfect for kids to develop cooking skills.

title: Fireside Solitaire
description:
Fireside Solitaire is a cozy card puzzle that combines logic and relaxation by the warmth of a crackling fire.
Place cards in sequence — one rank higher or lower than the current open card — to clear all columns.
Think ahead: once the draw pile runs out, it can’t be reshuffled, and the game ends.
Enjoy calm music, soft light, and the comforting atmosphere of a winter evening by the fireplace.

title: Jump to the Mountain for the Brainrots
description:
You'll play as Obby, a character located on a tall mountain.
Various Brainrots will randomly appear on the mountain, guarded by enemies.
Your task is to jump up the mountain and rescue the Brainrots. Collect the entire Brainrot collection without falling into enemy hands!
Sell Brainrots to increase your jump height and reach the very top of the mountain. Rare Brainrot species live at the very top.

title: EQ Test Puzzle
description: A puzzle game that tests emotional intelligence through emotion recognition and jigsaw puzzles. Match emotional icons, scenarios, and puzzle pieces to train your emotional awareness and problem-solving skills.

title: Doomsday Tower Defense
description:
Survive the zombie apocalypse in this fast-paced 2D top-down tower defense game. Construct and upgrade various defensive turrets to take down hordes of undead attackers.

Earn coins by killing zombies and use them to purchase new towers, upgrade existing ones, or sell for cash and reinvest into a different turret.

Defend your base from waves of shambling corpses as you fight to stay alive in a world gone mad.

title: Connect Puzzle Image
description: Step into the delightful world of Connect Puzzle Image, a game designed to tease your brain and sharpen your observation skills. Match and connect a variety of funny characters, tasty foods, and interesting objects as you progress through colorful levels. Easy to play yet delightfully challenging, this free online puzzle game offers hours of relaxing entertainment on both mobile and desktop devices.

title: Dino Game
description: Play Dino Game online! An offline-style dinosaur run for 1–3 players. Jump cacti, dodge flyers, unlock dinos, and race for high scores. Dino Game brings the classic offline dinosaur run to life with fast, responsive gameplay and local multiplayer. Dash across an endless desert, jump over cacti, and duck under swooping dinos as the speed steadily climbs. Play solo to beat your personal best, or switch to 2-player and 3-player modes to race friends on the same device.

title: Block Up
description: Block Up Contrast is a minimalist arcade game where you need a moving block upward through an endless series of obstacles. The challenge is to avoid barriers of contrasting colors while collecting points. The game requires precise timing and quick reflexes as the speed increases. With simple yet engaging gameplay, Block Up Contrast offers an addictive experience for players.

title: Elementz
description: ElementZ is a Match-3 game similar to Bejeweled or Candy Crush. Its particularity lies in giving each color its elemental power, allowing you to trigger different powers of fire (red), water (blue), earth (brown), plants (green), and electricity (yellow).

title: Eat Blobs Simulator
description: The battle of the blobs and slimes is beginning in this great eating simulator. Pick your slime character and start competing against others. Eat smaller blobs and slimes, and make yours bigger than the others. Become the king of the blob arena! Buy various blob skins during the game. On each game, receive various rewards with the blob sizes and coins. Chase smaller blobs and eat them. Collect blobs around and increase your score.

title: Fruit Catcher
description:
Catch as many fruits as you can before they fall! ?
Move your basket left and right to collect fresh fruits and avoid rotten ones. Each fruit gives you points — how high can your score go?
This fun and colorful game tests your reflexes and speed. Perfect for kids and casual players who love simple but addictive gameplay!

title: College Girl Coloring Dress Up
description:
BFF high school fashion makeover: coloring book & cool dress up games for girls!
New college girls dress up game & coloring book is here for you! Dress up the most popular high school girls, create their whole look, paint and color. These cool coloring pages and clothes design features made especially for fashion girls. Begin total fashion makeover with our girl dress up games!

Select a color and click on the fragment you want to color, when the painting of college girl is created, start drawing and coloring, become BFF fashion clothes designer.

Take screenshots, save as wallpaper, and share cute coloring pages with your friends and family absolutely for free.

title: Juicy Match
description: Tired of candies? Dive into Juicy Match and explore a world of natural, fresh, and juicy delights! You run the best Juice Bar in town, where you match a variety of fruits, from tropical to classic, to create the perfect juice blends. Your cheerful friend, Tiki will guide you with tips and tricks. Match three or more identical fruits to juice them and complete levels. Create chain reactions for extra bonuses and points. Enjoy a refreshing, juicy adventure with Juicy Match!

title: Mahjong build farm
description: A cozy blend of classic Mahjong and farm simulation! Start with a small green hill and turn it into a blooming farm by matching tiles and completing levels. The mechanics are simple and relaxing — find and match three identical picture tiles to clear the board. You'll have 90 unique levels with varying difficulty, from easy puzzles to real challenges for experienced players. If you get stuck, bonuses are always there to help.

title: Space Survival Rainbow Friends Monster
description: Begin a fun battle like never before in Space Survival - Rainbow Friends Monster! You’re in a mysterious space station overrun by terrifying rainbow monsters. Your task is to escape and rescue your friends. Use your gun to begin the battle. Avoid enemy attacks and unleash shooting combos against waves of enemies.

title: Solitaire Tail
description: Raise your dragons at Solitaire! Clear the game by moving all cards to the foundation! Move cards from the tableau or stockpile in ascending order of the same suit. In the tableau, you can stack cards in descending order with alternating colors! You can place a King card in an empty column! When there are no available moves, you can draw cards from the stockpile to the foundation or tableau!

title: Robot Terminator T Rex
description: Ready for an adventure in Robot Terminator T-Rex! Enter the wonderful world where robot dinosaurs and zombies collide in a nervous battle. You'll control a terrifying robotic T-Rex, equipped with powerful weapons and amazing abilities.

title: Merge Christmas
description: Merge Christmas is a festive puzzle game where you combine matching snowballs to create new character / bigger snowballs, and unlock a cozy Christmas world. Relax and merge Christmas-themed snowballs in a cheerful winter atmosphere perfect for the holiday season.

title: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue!
description: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue! is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game with lots of interesting puzzles. You will see several niches in it. They will be separated by partitions. In one niche you will see a fish, and in another water. You will need to carefully study everything and pull the pin. Thus, you will open it and water will get to the fish.

title: Hotel Fever Tycoon
description: Wanna be a Hotel Empire Tycoon or a Top Cooking Chef? Come to "Hotel Fever Tycoon" to start an interesting hotel management and cooking journey with Emma and Uncle George! Work together to build your world-class hotel chain!

title: Ball Eating Simulator
description: Get ready to have a great eating and growing fun under an open sky with cool balls inside different costumes in this great simulator game! Eat as much as balls around and get as much as big in the ball’s arena. Eat others, earn coins, and unlock new skins. Chase after gifts, rotate the lucky spin, or enjoy the everyday gifts to carry your eating simulator experience further. All you want is to become the king of the ball arena with your cool player.

title: Wacky Wheels
description:
? Wacky Wheels – Drift, Dodge & Dominate!
Master the chaos in Wacky Wheels, the ultimate test of timing and control!
Navigate wild tracks, drift through tight turns, dodge massive hammers, and collect stars — all before the clock runs out. Each level brings new challenges, themes, and physics that’ll keep you on the edge of your seat.

? It’s not just a race — it’s a wacky adventure of skill and speed!

title: Hexa Sort
description: Hexa Sort offers a delightful blend of puzzle challenges, strategic matching, and satisfying merging experience. Engage your mind with stimulating brain games that involve clever puzzle solving and logical maneuvers, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a mental workout.

Click the correctly colored cannon to obliterate matching dragon sections. Each precise cannon shot slows their advance toward the cat! Repeat until dragon threats vanish, but remember: rescue missions demand speed and sort puzzle accuracy!

Bubble Pop Legend is the best way to kill time.

title: Magic Solitaire
description: Welcome to the amazing magical world of solitaire! Your fairy helper will guide you through this magical world full of mystery and ancient secrets. Magic World Solitaire is the classic solitaire you love in an exciting new world.

title: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets
description: Combine flowers in the relaxing atmosphere of a summer garden and earn coins! Sell your bouquets to customers and clear your garden of unwanted flowers with your pruning shears! Earn more coins than other players to take a place on the leaderboard!

title: CS: Upgrade Gun
description: The weapon is alive and ready to go hunting! In this fast-paced launcher, you control a cannon that runs itself and shoots at targets. Collect boosters, improve their performance and last as long as possible. The further you go, the more action and explosions!

description: Hi there! It sounds like you're interested in playing Super Kid Adventure, an online game similar to Super Mario. description: Get ready for a wonderful pixel battle in Pixel Island War! This strategy game brings you to a wonderful pixel world. Here your task is to conquer islands and expand your empire. title: Gang War: Strike Shooter

Welcome to a fast-paced multiplayer shooter! Break out of prison and dive straight into a brutal gang war. Join the Reds or the Blues, capture banks, warehouses, factories, and other city locations. Each captured zone earns you income — spend it on new weapons and character customization!

 Come back every day to unlock new daily bonuses !

Experience the thrill of an addictive pet-catching simulator, perfect for Pokémon fans! Explore diverse Roblox worlds and level up your heroes all in one exciting adventure.

Catch pets in battles, hatch them from cases and eggs, and trade or purchase them to build a team of powerful allies and friends. description: Impostor Among Space is a thrilling single-player stealth game where you play as the Impostor aboard a spaceship full of unsuspecting AI crewmates. Your mission? Eliminate them one by one, sabotage critical systems, and avoid detection at all costs.

title: Riders Downhill Racing

title: Block Team Deathmatch
description: Block Team Deathmatch is a first-person shooting simulation game. All models are made of pixel blocks including scenes, characters, and weapons. We have 4v4 Team Mode, Individual Mode, and Sniper Mode for you to select. If I were you, I would play the Team Mode first for better equipment, then challenge the other 2 modes when the rank levels up. If you never played any shooting games, I recommend you buy an auto-rifle to fight at any distance. Keep calm and shoot first!

title: Bubble Shooter Free 3
description: Bubble Shooter Free 3 is back with a long-awaited 3rd sequel to one of the most popular bubble shooter games there is! This bubble shooter embraces endless gameplay that is designed for players to enjoy hours and hours of fun without time pressure. It boasts the ‘Bubble Swap’ feature which lets you swap the current bubble in your shooter with the incoming one as well as the BOMB which creates huge explosions popping 15 bubbles at once! Now the players can play even more strategically!

title: Bomber Battle Arena
description: Bomber Battle Arena is an exciting 3D collecting game that lets you play as a bomb-wielding character. Your goal is to strategically detonate bombs to clear various green plants and tree stumps, collect a golden key, and reach the treasure chest to advance to the next level. Be careful of the bomb’s blast radius and avoid contact with other monsters along the way. Get ready for an explosive adventure through 10 challenging levels full of explosive action!

title: Ultra Realistic BlockCraft
description: Help Steve in the ultra-realistic block world and make sure he reaches the portal. Remember, this realistic world is extremely challenging and monsters are roaming everywhere. You must collect all the diamonds. While collecting diamonds, don’t forget to open the chests you find along the way. Open the chests and crush all the monsters. Reach the portal at the end of the level safely to complete the stage. Remember, you only have one life and if it runs out you will lose everything you’ve earned.

title: Hero Pipe
description: The hero began his journey for treasure and to save the princess, but the puzzles in front of the hunter trapped him. What you need to do is to connect the pipes in the right order, so that the hero can take the hidden treasure and save the princess away from the dragons, wolves and monsters safely.

title: Cubatoria Merge 2048
description:
Welcome to the exciting world of Cubatoria Merge 2048! This game combines elements of the classic 2048 game with a three-dimensional visual design, which makes it unique and exciting.

The game is designed for fans of puzzles, logic games and those who appreciate a creative approach to classic concepts. Cubatoria Merge 2048 promises an exciting immersion in virtual space with the opportunity to enjoy a new visual experience.

title: Bubble Shooter Witch Tower 2
description: Bubble Shooter: Witch Tower 2 brings back the magic in a fun, family-friendly way! Pop colorful bubbles, unlock cozy enchanted rooms, and help the Witch Tower shine again. Meet adorable familiars, enjoy charming details, and celebrate the magic of every season — even a touch of Halloween spookiness! Easy to play for all ages, with plenty of bubble-shooting fun to enjoy anytime.

title: Pocket Parking
description: Get all the cars out of the parking lot wthin the time limit! The car goes straight forward and backward. Move it in a direction where there are no walls or cars.

title: Draw Bridge Puzzle
description: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a creative and exciting puzzle game that combines drawing and rescue gameplay into one addictive experience. You become a bridge designer, using your finger to draw safe paths and complete thrilling rescue missions. Enter the car mode, draw a strong bridge to help a motor cross gaps, broken roads, and dangerous obstacles to reach the goal.

title: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin
description:
You will be immersed in the dangerous world of ninja art, where every movement, every breath are decisive moments in your mission.

Your goal is to approach your enemies unnoticed, and to achieve this, you will have to skillfully use your blade to cut through the bamboo thickets, making your way through the dense forest.

But be on your guard, your enemies are not slumbering, and you can be detected at any moment.

title: Elevator Fight
description: Make your way to the top floor, one fight at a time. Every level, a new challenger steps in, but only one can ride up! With simple controls and over 130 levels, this game offers quick, close-quarters combat in a cramped elevator. Upgrade your fighter’s speed, power, and defense to keep up with the ever-changing, humorous opponents. What’s waiting at the top?

title: Crazy Axe
description:
In Crazy Axe, you take control of a fearless warrior, armed with a powerful axe, to conquer a series of action-packed challenges. Swing your axe with precision, crush obstacles, and defeat waves of enemies. The game tests your reflexes and accuracy as you navigate through dangerous environments, dodging traps and outsmarting your foes. With each level, the difficulty ramps up, demanding quick thinking and faster reactions to survive.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and go axe-crazy?

title: Gummy merge
description: Jelly merge is an endless game in which to merge identical marmalades. The goal of the game is to reach the final marmalade.

title: Stickman Ragdoll Playground
description: Build-A-Flop: The Sickman Playground is not just a game—it's a people's playground of laughter and creativity! With its whimsical world and endless opportunities for hilarity, it's sure to become a favorite among players of all ages.

title: Stack Fall
description:
Smash the floor! 
Are you under stress? Maybe Stack Fall can help you to release the stress. 
As your ball keep breaking the floors to get to the goal, every smashing will ease your stress. 
It's time to break some stacks!

title: Bus Color Jam
description: Welcome to Bus Color Jam, a lively and colorful online game that challenges your coordination and quick thinking. Guide passengers to the right buses by matching their colors and keeping the station running smoothly. Every level brings new challenges that test your timing and attention. It’s a fun mix of strategy and reflexes — easy to learn, satisfying to master, and completely free to play on both your phone and computer.

title: Digging Moles
description: Dig, guide, and solve! In this physics-based puzzle game, tap or click to dig tunnels and create paths for cute, ball-shaped moles. Your mission is to help each mole roll into the correct colored pipe. Use gravity and smart digging to guide them through challenging terrain filled with obstacles, slopes, and surprises. Timing, precision, and a bit of creativity are key! With charming visuals and satisfying mechanics, this game offers fun and brain-teasing puzzles for players of all ages.

title: Cake Sorting Deluxe
description: Cake Sorting Deluxe is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that challenges your sorting skills! Shift cakes across shelves to make matches of three or more. Clear the board, uncover hidden and shadowed cakes, and solve tricky puzzles as you go. With cute visuals, smooth gameplay, and lots of sweet challenges, Cake Sorting Deluxe is a treat for anyone who loves a good puzzle. Ready to mix, match, and clear the shelves?

title: Alchemy Puzzle
description:
We create challenges with fun puzzles, challenge your brain and make you always smile on your lips.
Alchemy Puzzle will help you have moments of light entertainment, combined with puzzle play and fun real life characters.
If you've ever played games: puzzlers, word games, trivia games, quiz games, brain teasers, or just want to spend time have time to relax, let try Alchemy Puzzle, It's for you.

title: Magic and Wizards Match
description: Magic and Wizards is an enchanting Match 3 game where you and your friend Aurora embark on a mystical journey through a magical realm. With over 4000+ levels, match gems representing magical elements to overcome obstacles, using powerful boosters to progress. Complete Daily Missions, tackle tricky blockers, and uncover hidden treasures. With stunning graphics and immersive gameplay, Magic & Wizards delivers a captivating experience filled with mystery. Ready for your magical adventure?

title: From Nerd To School Popular
description: Embark on a transformation journey “From Nerd To School Popular”! Help our protagonist navigate high school life, overcome challenges, and discover their true potential. With your guidance, they’ll undergo a stylish makeover, gain confidence, and rise to the top of the social ladder. Experience the ultimate high school makeover story and watch as our hero transforms from a shy outsider to a beloved school icon!

title: Seat Puzzle Cut The Rope
description: Face a wildly satisfying brain challenge in Seat Puzzle - Cut The Rope. This addictive puzzle game blends smart logic with relaxing casual gameplay, creating the perfect experience for those who love thinking fast and solving clever challenges! In each level, chairs are bound by ropes. Your task is to cut the ropes according to the passengers' colors.

title: Perfect Cake Maker
description: Get ready to make some seriously delicious cakes in Perfect Cake Maker! It’s a delightful casual simulation game. When you start, you’ll see a fully stocked kitchen and delicious guests waiting. First, choose the cake base based on your guests’ needs. Then comes the fun part – mixing the ingredients!

title: Egg Hunt Mania
description: Get your basket ready and save all the eggs you can from a terrible fate. Make sure to empty a full basket into the store. Watch out for the rising quota for eggs each day!

title: Stickman Archero Fight: stick shadow fight war
description:
Complete levels, collecting items that you can then put on yourself and improve in your inventory. You can finish off your enemies with colorful fatalities. Try different skill combinations to complete as many levels as possible. 
Game features:

- Fights with stickmen
- Skins: warrior, fighter, ninja
- Enemies: red stickman, black stickman
- Various biomes

Did you like the game "Stickman Archero Fight: stick shadow fight war"? - Then write a review and play all our games about stickmen.

title: Crush the Eggs
description: In this game, eggs have appeared that you will have to fight with and break. In front of you on the screen you will see a platform on which the egg will be located. Above it you will see a special field. Using the mouse you can draw any object on it. When you finish your actions, this item will fall directly onto the egg. If your calculations are correct, then you will break it and thus destroy it. After this you will move to the next level of the game.

title: 2 Player Games Kids Kitchen
description: Do you want to run your own restaurant? Want to experience the blend of collaboration and cooking fun? Join H5games4u's best restaurant tycoon game and enjoy cooking fun. You will engage in different gaming modes. The best part is that you can work together with your friends in the virtual restaurant!

title: Safe Merge
description: A simple idle merge game, you need to merge safes with same design to make a safe more powerfull, you need to unlock all design to win the game, the design are in the right, if the game was hard you can do prestige to win more money per cicle.

title: Mojicon Winter Connect
description:
The Mojicon series returns for the holidays! Match festive tiles, break the new Ice Sheet blockers, and enjoy a relaxing winter puzzle adventure. ❄️
Mojicon Winter Connect takes the classic Onet matching fun you love and covers it in a layer of fresh snow. Immerse yourself in a cozy holiday atmosphere, connecting festive icons like reindeer, gingerbread men, and happy snowmen.
Fast, satisfying, and full of seasonal charm – it’s the perfect winter puzzle for all ages. ✨✨✨

title: Animal Blocks
description: Enter the colorful and cheerful world of Animal Blocks, where adorable creatures bring classic block puzzles to life. Match three or more of the same animal blocks to clear the board, earn points, and climb to higher scores. Simple to play yet full of fun challenges, this free online game is perfect for both mobile and desktop players who enjoy relaxing, strategic gameplay and charming visuals.

title: Forest Glade Mysteries
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Forest Glade Mysteries — a magical forest where the cutest animals live! Each level introduces you to new fluffy friends and exciting challenges. This forest is full of mysteries, and every step brings you closer to uncovering ancient secrets!

title: Rocket Fest
description: Control the rocket to collect energy or other useful props along the way, and bomb the target at the end! This is a casual stress relief game.

title: Monster Vs Zombie
description: Slide the monster to help it eat all the zombies in the way. Use your strategic thinking and problem solving skill to avoid all obstacle and reach the gate to go to the next level.

title: Office Brawl - Room Smash
description:
Become the hero of an office rebellion and destroy everything in your path! The player will have to transform into a disgruntled employee who challenges the system, destroys obstacles and fights the boss.

Use brute force and ingenuity to get through difficult tests, participate in intense battles and explosive actions.
Become an antihero and sow chaos from start to finish!

title: Real Freekick 3D
description: Immerse yourself in the intensity of Real Freekick 3D, a penalty shootout game where the championship's fate hangs on a nail-biting series of penalty shots. Select your preferred soccer team and progress to the finals. The pressure is on – make every shot count!

title: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park
description: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park is a horror escape adventure where bright amusement park rides hide lurking dangers. Players must solve puzzles, collect items, and uncover clues while evading hostile enemies. Stealth and timing are crucial—explore cautiously, hide when needed, and outsmart the threats to survive and escape. The mix of colorful setting and eerie tension creates a unique, suspenseful experience.

title: Chill Clicker
description: Chill Clicker is a clicker game where you multiply the Chill Capybara population by clicking. You can buy various upgrades to increase the output of Chill Capybaras, change the weather, and unlock new skins to make you the coolest Chill Capybara in town.

title: Brainrots Lava Survive Online
description: Brainrots Lava Survive Online is an intense survival experience where rising lava transforms the map into a dangerous obstacle zone. Players must collect brainrots in risky areas and escape before the lava blocks safe routes. Online mode is available in 1 Player, allowing chat and interaction, while 2 Player mode offers local shared-screen competition. With more than 60 characters in normal, gold, diamond, Celestial, and time-limited Divine tiers, progression stays dynamic.

title: Pocket Car Master
description:
Pocket Car Master: The Ultimate Car Puzzle Game
Collect and merge parts to make your own robot car. Park it in the matching area and fight other robots. No time limit, just fun. Upgrade your car with coins and unlock more cars. Try and play now!

title: Merge Racer Stunts Car
description:
Welcome to Merge Racer - Stunts Car! This is an exciting and creative racing game. You show your driving skills and use the power of merge to build supercars! Merge the same types of cars to create stronger racing machines. Each merge improves your car’s performance, helping
you speed ahead of your rivals.

title: Horse Champs
description: Raise, train, and compete with your champion horse to secure first place in this thrilling horse racing simulation game. Strategize and master the art of competition.

title: Hexa Stack Christmas
description: Get into the holiday spirit with Hexa Stack Christmas: a festive twist on the classic hexagon-stacking puzzle game. Place the Christmas-themed hexagon tiles stacks onto the board and sort the same color tiles to collect them. The game combines a light puzzle that requires attention and logic — perfect for relaxing while stimulating your brain. 2 game modes, infinite levels, a user-friendly interface, and save support let you play anytime without losing progress.

title: Robots Gone Wild
description:
Robots Gone Wild is a thrilling survival game in a sci-fi world with captivating visuals and intense shooting mechanics. Your goal is to escape from rogue robots and destroy them while navigating through hazardous environments.

To survive, keep upgrading your character and weapons.
Improve your armor, and unlock powerful guns to fend off waves of increasingly powerful robots. 

Engage in exciting battles, and explore beautiful environments that immerse you in the chaos of a world gone wild.

title: Astral Escape
description: Astral Escape is a thrilling space game where you dodge asteroids, outsmart aliens, and survive cosmic traps in a fast escape game adventure. Explore galaxies in a sci-fi arcade escape with astronaut missions and star quests. Fans of cool math games, Roblox, Minecraft, snake game, or Kahoot-style challenges will enjoy this galaxy escape quest. Astral Escape blends action, strategy, and fun into one cosmic survival run.

title: Spooky Chains
description: Spooky Chains is a fun Halloween puzzle game. Tap a tile and drag through matching nearby items to make a chain of 3 or more. The items vanish, and the tiles turn golden. Your goal is to turn all tiles golden. Sometimes a Flying Witch glides across the board. Tap her while she flies to watch a reward ad. After the ad, she blasts some tiles into golden. You can also watch a reward ad to remove the timer and play without time pressure.

title: Lulus Fashion World
description: Welcome to Lulu’s Fashion World. Can you battle to become the top fashion designer? Collect stars, progress through cities and events. Choose from clothes you own from plenty categories. Style outfits your way and save them to use whenever you like. The combinations of clothing and makeup are at your fingertips to experiment and create unique trends that could become the new fashion trend. Experiment with new looks and create a fad. So, are you ready to be the new fashion icon ?

title: Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey with Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure, where quick thinking and strategy collide in an exciting online card challenge. Build your deck, make smart moves, and face thrilling encounters that test your skills and timing. Designed for both desktop and mobile players, this free-to-play adventure delivers fast, tactical gameplay and endless replayability. Every decision shapes your path — can you conquer the quest in just ten minutes?
